2. The First Appeal is directed against the order dated 5-2-2013 (decree signed on 12-2-2013) by which the learned Joint District Judge, 1st Court, Dhaka rejected the plaint of Title Suit No. 868 of 2010. 

 22. Mr Islam lastly submits that the trial court committed an error of law in rejecting the plaint upon an erroneous finding relying on clause 15 of the agreement and therefore the appeal should be allowed and the impugned decree should be set aside and the Civil Rule should be made absolute by granting temporary injunction. 

 43. The order dated 5-2-2013 (decree dated 12-2-2013) passed by the learned Joint District Judge, 1st Court, Dhaka in Title Suit No. 868 of 2010 rejecting the plaint is hereby set aside.
